annotations.title: Check the status of a request

description: The status of a request sent with company_request, by its request id: held (waiting for review, the company has not been emailed), queued (not emailed: no contact address on file, or the company's daily limit was reached), sent (emailed to the company), failed (the email could not be sent) or suppressed (the company asked not to receive requests). Returns the status only, never the request or any address. Free, no auth.

requestId.description: The request id company_request returned, starts with req_

name: company_request_status
